_README: Reference numbers the dashboard compares our local runs against.
IMPORTANT -- these are NOT measured by this suite and are NOT verified by it.
Every entry must carry a 'source' URL and an 'as_of' date so a reader can
check it. Entries with source set to null are placeholders: the dashboard
renders them as 'unverified' and they must not be cited as fact.
Equally important -- a published MMMU score is NOT directly comparable to
this suite's number. Published scores are the full 900-item validation set
(or the withheld 10.5k test set) scored with the official prompt and
parser. This suite runs a 60-item stratified subset with its own prompt
and answer extraction. Treat the comparison as an order-of-magnitude
sanity check ('are we in the right neighbourhood, or is vision broken?'),
never as a leaderboard claim. The 'comparability' field records this per
